input.question: What is the population of East Brooklyn?

documents.text: There were 5,000 people, 668 households, and 378 families residing in the CDP. The population density was 1,189.9 people/km² (3,082 people/sq mi). There were 690 housing units at an average density of 163.4 units/km² (423 units/sq mi). The racial makeup of the CDP was 94.30% White, 2.04% African American, 0.81% Native American, 0.75% Asian, 0.41% from other races, and 1.70% from two or more races. Hispanic or Latino of any race were 1.83% of the population.
